snc.text: Giada is a teenage angel kept secret by the Cabaretti, who discover she can turn sewage into pure Halo, and at the Crescendo Jinnie leads her onstage where she touches an empty bottle and it fills with Halo.
Elspeth realizes the Cabaretti's new era will cost the exhausted Giada her life, so when the Adversary's forces attack and Jinnie abandons Giada to rush to Jetmir, Elspeth offers to take her away.
Vivien helps them flee with spectral wolves and a dragon, and in a warehouse Giada confesses her fear that her magic is not enough while Elspeth vows to keep her safe.
Giada's Halo heals the mortally wounded Elspeth, and in the cathedral where the angels' statues sing, Giada says it is her family and she is home.
